_comment: Smallest config that works. Grow the targets map as the run reports accumulate 'unmapped path' warnings — that is the intended maintenance loop.

tierA.comment: Agent instructions — always escalate, never auto-edit.

targetsNote: When a changed path matches more than one 'code' glob, the most specific (longest) match wins.

provenance.rule: THE STAMP IS THE CERTIFICATION, NOT THE BASELINE. Every doc verified in a run — edited, or checked and found current — gets stamped with the HEAD sha. A doc the run never looked at keeps its old stamp and stays visibly stale in doc-audit, instead of being silently certified by a baseline bump it never participated in.
